name: Statistics Transparency 3
definition: Statistics for a financial instrument generated as part of transparency calculations.

AverageDailyTurnover.name: Average Daily Turnover
AverageDailyTurnover.definition: Average Daily Turnover for the instrument in Euros.

AverageTransactionValue.name: Average Transaction Value
AverageTransactionValue.definition: Average value of the transactions for the instrument in Euro.

LargeInScale.name: Large In Scale
LargeInScale.definition: Large in scale order in respect of a share, depositary receipt, certificate or other similar financial instrument shall be considered large in scale compared with normal market size if, on the basis of the average daily turnover for that financial instrument, the order is equal to or larger than the minimum size of orders set out in the local regulation.

StandardMarketSize.name: Standard Market Size
StandardMarketSize.definition: Standard market size for shares, depositary receipts, ETFs, certificates and other similar financial instruments for which there is a liquid market shall be determined on the basis of the average value of transactions for each financial instrument and in accordance with the local regulation.

AverageDailyNumberOfTransactions.name: Average Daily Number Of Transactions
AverageDailyNumberOfTransactions.definition: Average daily number of transactions that have been performed on this market.

TotalNumberOfTransactionsExecuted.name: Total Number Of Transactions Executed
TotalNumberOfTransactionsExecuted.definition: Total number of transactions that have been performed on this market.

TotalVolumeOfTransactionsExecuted.name: Total Volume Of Transactions Executed
TotalVolumeOfTransactionsExecuted.definition: Total volume of transactions that have been performed on this market.

TotalNumberOfTradingDays.name: Total Number Of Trading Days
TotalNumberOfTradingDays.definition: The total number of trading days for which the data is provided.
